mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, target_role, target_experience_band, career_stage, target_level, target_company, java_skill_level, ai_skill_level, target_interview_date, created_at, updated_at FROM job_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE job_profile SET target_role = #{targetRole}, target_experience_band = #{targetExperienceBand}, career_stage = #{careerStage}, target_level = #{targetLevel}, target_company = #{targetCompany}, java_skill_level = #{javaSkillLevel}, ai_skill_level = #{aiSkillLevel}, target_interview_date = #{targetInterviewDate}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
